description_zh: 查询云连接器实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-iot-cloud-connectors --iot-cloud-connector-status Created --iot-cloud-connector-ids iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --iot-cloud-connector-name test --isp mobile --vpc-id vpc-bp1aevy8sofi8mh1q0000 --apn CMWAP --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-in-group false --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIoTCloudConnectors

parameters.help_en:
The status of the cloud connector instance. You can specify up to 20 instance statuses. Valid values:  
Creating: Creation in progress.  
Created: Creation completed.  
Deleting: Deletion in progress.  
Updating: Modification in progress.
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的状态。最多支持输入20个实例状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。
Created：创建完成。
Deleting：删除中。
Updating：修改中
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_status

parameters.help_en: A list of cloud connector instance IDs
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cloud connector instance. You can specify up to 20 instance names.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的名称。最多支持输入20个实例名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_name

parameters.help_en:
The carrier of the cloud connector instance. You can specify up to 20 carriers. Valid values:
telecom: China Telecom.
mobile: China Mobile.
unicom: China Unicom
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的运营商。最多支持输入20个实例的运营商。取值：
telecom：中国电信。
mobile：中国移动。
unicom：中国联通
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC connected to the cloud connector instance
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例连接的VPC的ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the carrier APN.
parameters.name: apn

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.
If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page when querying results in batches. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default Value: 10.
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.  

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to obtain the region ID.
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query instances in an instance group. Valid values:

true: Query instances in an instance group.

false (default): Do not query instances in an instance group.

null: Query all instances regardless of whether they belong to an instance group
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询实例组中的实例。取值：

true：查询实例组中的实例。

false（默认值）：不查询实例组中的实例。

null：全量查询实例，不区分实例是否在实例组中
parameters.name: is_in_group

parameters.help_en: The group ID of the cloud connector instance.
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id

APN.description_en: The ID of the carrier APN

CreateTime.description_en:
The Creation Time of the cloud connector instance.

It is represented in ISO 8601 standard and uses UTC. The format is: `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
CreateTime.description_zh:
云连接器实例创建时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

GrantAliUid.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud authorizer

ISP.description_en:
Carrier of the cloud connector instance. Valid values:
telecom: China Telecom.
mobile: China Mobile.
unicom: China Unicom
ISP.description_zh:
云连接器实例的运营商。取值：
telecom：中国电信。
mobile：中国移动。
unicom：中国联通

IoTCloudConnectorBusinessStatus.description_en:
The Run status of the cloud connector instance. Valid values:
Normal: Normal.
Abnormal: Abnormal
IoTCloudConnectorBusinessStatus.description_zh:
云连接器实例的运行状态。取值：
Normal：正常。
Abnormal：不正常

IoTCloudConnectorDescription.description_en: Description of the cloud connector instance
IoTCloudConnectorDescription.description_zh: 云连接器实例描述信息

IoTCloudConnectorGroupId.description_en: The group ID of the cloud connector instance

IoTCloudConnectorId.description_en: The instance ID of the cloud connector

IoTCloudConnectorName.description_en: Name of the cloud connector instance

IoTCloudConnectorStatus.description_en:
The status of the cloud connector instance. Valid values:
Creating: Creating.
Created: Created.
Deleting: Deleting.
Updating: Updating
IoTCloudConnectorStatus.description_zh:
云连接器实例的状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。
Created：创建完成。
Deleting：删除中。
Updating：修改中

Mode.description_en: The Attribute Value of the cloud connector. Indicates that return Ingress is displayed when the current mode is passTrough
Mode.description_zh: 云连接器的属性值。表示当前属于passTrough模式时显示回程路由

ModifyTime.description_en:
The time when the cloud connector instance information was modified.

This time is represented in ISO 8601 format and uses UTC. The format is: `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
ModifyTime.description_zh:
云连接器实例信息修改时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

RateLimit.description_en: The peak bandwidth of the cloud connector instance. Unit: Gbps. Valid values: 1 to 10
RateLimit.description_zh: 云连接器实例的带宽峰值。单位：Gbps，取值范围：1~10

ServiceType.description_en:
Service Type. Valid values:

Normal: Normal type.
CC5G: Cloud connector 5G instance hosting type.
CC5GCCIoT: Cloud connector 5G transfer type
ServiceType.description_zh:
服务类型。取值：

Normal：普通型。
CC5G：云连接器5G实例托管类型。
CC5GCCIoT：云连接器5G过户类型

Type.description_en:
The version of the cloud connector instance. Different versions have different feature limitations and billing policies. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition.

Standard: Standard Edition.

<props="china">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. To create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today).</props>

<props="intl">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. To create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex).</props>
Type.description_zh:
云连接器实例的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Basic：基础版。

Standard：标准版。

<props="china">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today)申请。</props>

<props="intl">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex)申请</props>

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the cloud connector instance is connected
VpcId.description_zh: 云连接器实例连接的VPC的ID

WildcardDomainEnabled.description_en:
Whether the wildcard domain name feature is Enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: shutdown
WildcardDomainEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启泛域名功能。取值：
true：开启。
false：关闭

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries to display per page when performing a paginated query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, there is no subsequent query.
If NextToken has a return value, this value represents the token to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: Total number of entries in the list
